vb_textbox.text: The time you take to either choose the gnome or pick mushrooms doesn't really matter, just do it as quickly as possible. The number of mushrooms you'll get based on the colour of the gnome or their hats changes during the game. You have to figure out which gnome gives you more mushrooms and it changes during the game. Just try to be as fast as possible to don't miss any round and stay focused on which type of gnome gives you more mushrooms in a few recent rounds. Good luck!
